_note: Market Profile cases for core.marketprofile.build_profile, build_composite, untested_pocs, overnight_profile and default_row_size. Read by packages/core/tests/test_marketprofile.py and by the console's web/test/marketProfile.test.ts, which pins its TypeScript port (web/src/lib/marketProfile.ts) to the same answers. Change both implementations or neither. The first case and the first composite are also worked by hand in the Python test; the rest are seeded random walks whose expected profiles the module produced when this file was made, so they pin the two implementations to each other. A composite's `bars_from` names the case whose bars it reads.
